summary: Ten blocks of one repeated rhythm: a slanted-photo head, a navy tagline band, then eight alternating text and slanted-photo rows, one per reason, and a closing call to action. Needs eight reasons of 2 to 3 short paragraphs each and about nine photos of staff at work.

sections.note: cream ground; orange label, navy title and a lead left; team photo right cut by two diagonal stripes (orange and navy); no buttons
full-width navy band 272px with one large white tagline, repeated on every About page
eight rows of 450 to 800px alternating image side: navy uppercase heading, two or three paragraphs, and a photo with one slanted edge; the photo bleeds to the page edge
heading and a button left, photo of two staff over a diagonal orange shape right
